description: This course aims to introduce students to different pattern mining tools and techniques for complex data considering different real time constraints on data analysis pertaining to different application domains.

syllabus.title: Pattern Mining
syllabus.body: Maximal and closed patterns, pattern mining in multilevel and multidimensional space, constraint-based pattern generation, mining high-dimensional data and colossal patterns, mining compressed patterns by pattern clustering, sequential pattern mining.

syllabus.title: Advanced Clustering
syllabus.body: Clustering high-dimensional data, challenges in subspace clustering, CLIQUE, PROCLUS, clustering graph and network data, similarity measures, clustering with constraints.

syllabus.title: Anomaly Detection
syllabus.body: Types of anomalies, statistical approaches, proximity based approaches, supervised approaches, mining contextual and collective anomalies.

syllabus.title: Analysis of Complex Data and Case Studies
syllabus.body: Algorithms for analysis of spatial data, graph data, text data, time series data; case studies in medical, finance, environment, and transportation domains.

outcomes: Design efficient algorithms for finding patterns and clusters in complex data.
Design techniques for detecting anomalies in data.
Analyse real data coming from different domains such as medical, transport, environment etc.
textbooks: Tan, Pang-Ning, Michael Steinbach, and Vipin Kumar, Introduction to Data Mining, Pearson Education India, 2016.
Han, Jiawei, et al., Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques, Third Edition, Morgan Kaufmann Publishers, 2012.
